metadata.title: Bounds for lattice points in terms of volume and successive minima
metadata.abstract: We prove, in every dimension, the upper bound conjectured by Betke, Henk and Wills for the lattice-point enumerator in terms of volume and successive minima. For every convex body $K\subset R^n$ and full-rank lattice $\Lambda$, we establish $$ \#(K\cap\Lambda)\le\frac{\mathrm{vol}_n(K)}{\det\Lambda}\prod_{i=1}^n\left(1+\frac{i\lambda_i}{2}\right), $$ where $\lambda_i$ are the successive minima of $(K-K)/2$ with respect to $\Lambda$. Equality holds precisely for lattice translates of positive integral dilates of unimodular simplices. We also prove $$ \#(\mathrm{int}K\cap\Lambda)\ge\frac{\mathrm{vol}_n(K)}{\det\Lambda} \left(1-\frac{n}{4}\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}\lambda_i-\frac{n}{2}\lambda_n\right), $$ which implies the lower estimate with factor $1-\frac{1}{2}\sum_{i=1}^n i\lambda_i$. In dimension two we prove the lower bound with factor $(1-\lambda_1/2)(1-\lambda_2)$ when $\lambda_2\le1$. We also observe that a conjectured product lower bound for origin-symmetric bodies fails in dimension three. The proofs combine geometric compression, lattice-cell counts in coordinate sections, and an elementary coefficient comparison.

analysis.progressType: 尖锐不等式与等号分类
analysis.workSummary: 对非空内部的n维凸体K和满秩格Λ，作者声称证明含体积的Betke–Henk–Wills上界：格点数不超过vol(K)/detΛ乘以各(1+iλ_i/2)的乘积，λ_i为(K−K)/2的逐次极小值。等号当且仅当K是一个格向量平移的、正整数倍的幺模单纯形。另给出一般维内部格点数的线性下界和平面λ₂≤1时的乘积下界。
techniques: 向反阻塞体归约与保体积的对角压缩
坐标截面中的格胞计数
有序系数比较及等号分析
analysis.breakthrough: 将带体积的上界从已有二维情形推广到任意维，并完全刻画等号；内部计数的线性项系数也得到尖锐性例子。还指出原点对称体的另一个乘积下界在三维存在反例。
analysis.limitations: 解决的是文中(1.3)这一含体积上界，不是仍在n≥4开放的纯逐次极小值乘积取整型离散Minkowski猜想(1.2)；一般维下界也未被提升为全部猜想乘积下界。幺模性相对于给定格，等号平移必须属于该格，倍数必须为正整数。已读第1–3页主结果和路线，未独立验证后续压缩构造与系数证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。已检索完整 18 页文本及点写 AI、跨行模型名、Danus，核对首页及末尾正文、参考文献，未观察到作者自用生成式 AI 的正面披露。这不等于确认未用 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 尖锐几何不等式值得关注，但主要属于数的几何而非黎曼比较几何。
